versions.summary: Registry content is never duplicated: tagged prose blocks become projection blocks. layered-diagram and labelling tile kinds retired. Declared block roles, multi-block questions, construct-region and run response modes, the version contract.
The artefact is a resource, not a lesson. First public publication. The June to July 2026 consolidation to the single bento block type happened under this label without a version change.
keyLearningPoints merge into objectives; klpIds become objectiveIds; registry-realising prose blocks become first-class types; pupilLessonOutcome removed.
First versioned shape: seventeen block types in three families, typed groups, a key-learning-points registry beside objectives.
